status: quarantine candidate; mechanical deliverables complete; visual and west-seam self-checks fail

generation.mode: single built-in ImageGen whole-canvas edit with the edit target and canon attached

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No coherent whole-cell sun direction or cast-shadow field is visible, but basalt caps and some conifer branch tiers remain brighter than adjacent faces. The aggregate metric does not prove the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad forest plateau and the two natural bank shelves count as buildable ground; inlet and coastal column faces count as steep; talus, broken shoreline rock, and uncertain densely vegetated margins make up the remainder.

crown.method: Full-cell census of all 118 visually separable conifer crowns located by the diagnostic component survey, including saplings and edge crowns; outer-foliage widths were checked at 2x and the median 22 source px was scaled by 2560/1254 at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.componentNote: The sea and inlet are one connected system; the remaining components are visible stream, fall, foam, and ripple fragments separated in the painted source by crowns, rock, or unpainted gaps.
waterMask.method: Native-resolution cool-water classification constrained to the hand-traced stream and inlet envelope, expanded through adjacent shallows and neutral foam, with the south edge forced to water corner to corner; the complete result was inspected as a magenta overlay.

seamSelfCheck.method: Local reproduction of the pipeline 16-176 final-pixel median bands after applying the delivered water mask; System.Drawing high-quality bicubic resampling was used because the sandbox permits node --version but denies node script execution.

selfCheckFailures: The west vegetation band misses c0-2 materially: dLuma 36.801 exceeds 13 and dBG 0.289448 exceeds 0.20, although the all-land west tone passes.
Basalt caps and conifer branch tiers retain visible intra-form value changes, so the literal neutral-face and one-flat-value-per-crown rules are not met by eye.
The inlet is broad at the sea but narrows early, and the facing rock shoulders are not both clearly level and tree-free across an approximately 30 m crossing.
verificationLimits: The mutating stitch command was not run because this task is quarantine-only and a passing gate would write outside the permitted directory.
The seam proxy uses bicubic rather than the pipeline's Lanczos resampling; the west miss is too large to be plausibly explained by that kernel difference.
Seam invisibility, shoreline-mask judgment, geological naturalism, and overall visual quality remain director and owner visual judgments.
